verdict.rationale: The pricing page offers deployment in your own dedicated instance or VPC, but only as a sales-gated enterprise tier with tailored pricing. A community commenter independently reports that self-hosting the official Docker image was hassle-free. The first-party docs, however, center on the hosted API and Transform platform, and no self-hosting installation guide appears in evidence. Missing for 10: first-party self-host/Docker installation documentation, evidence of a freely available self-hostable core outside the enterprise VPC tier, and clarity on feature parity between self-hosted and hosted versions.
